New York: The woman wanted in Wednesday's Diamond District stabbing is under arrest — and struck twice that day, police say.

Anna Mochalova, 32, of Brooklyn, was arrested Saturday, charged with eight counts of assault, eight of menacing, two of harassment, two of weapons possession.

Hours earlier, NYPD says the same suspect struck a 37-year-old man nearby. Both cases are probed as hate crimes.
